description: Hotjar site loader on static.hotjar.com/c/hotjar-{hjid}.js, whose site ID rides in the path.

params.name: hjid
params.description: It is the numeric Hotjar site ID. The published tracking code loads `hotjar-{hjid}.js`.
params.fix_hint: Copy the tracking code from Hotjar so the path carries your site ID.

params.name: sv
params.description: It is the snippet version (`hjsv`) the generated tracking code sends as `sv`.
params.fix_hint: Keep `sv` from the generated Hotjar snippet.
